## Original article text

````markdown
## Description

Undoes the attachment caused by the [Attach Players](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/attach%2Bplayers) action for one or more players. These players will resume normal movement from their current position.

## Snippet

```
Detach Players(Event Player);
```
````
